  • Method Details

    • testEquivalence

      public static <I, O> boolean testEquivalence(MMLT<?,I,?,O> modelA, MMLT<?,I,?,O> modelB, Collection<? extends TimedInput<I>> inputs)
      Tests whether two MMLTs are equivalent, i.e. whether there exists a findSeparatingWord(MMLT, MMLT, Collection) separating word} for the two given automata.
      Type Parameters:
      I - input symbol type (of non-delaying inputs)
      O - output symbol type
      Parameters:
      modelA - the one automaton to consider
      modelB - the other automaton to consider
      inputs - the input symbols to consider
      Returns:
      true if the automata are equivalent, false otherwise.
      See Also:
      • findSeparatingWord(MMLT, MMLT, Collection)

    • findSeparatingWord

      public static <I, O> @Nullable Word<TimedInput<I>> findSeparatingWord(MMLT<?,I,?,O> modelA, MMLT<?,I,?,O> modelB, Collection<? extends TimedInput<I>> inputs)
      Finds a separating word for two MMLTs. A separating word is a word that exposes a different output behavior in the respective semantic automata of the two MMLTs.
      Type Parameters:
      I - input symbol type (of non-delaying inputs)
      O - output symbol type
      Parameters:
      modelA - the one automaton to consider
      modelB - the other automaton to consider
      inputs - the input symbols to consider
      Returns:
      a separating word, or null if no such word could be found.

    • getConfigurationCount

      public static <S> long getConfigurationCount(MMLT<S,?,?,?> mmlt, S location)
      Returns the number of configurations for the given location. This is defined as follows:
      • When l has no timers: one
      • When l has a one-shot timer: initial value of this timer
      • When l only has periodic timers: least-common multiple of their initial values
      Type Parameters:
      S - location type
      Parameters:
      mmlt - the MMLT
      location - the considered location
      Returns:
      the maximum configuration time, Long.MAX_VALUE if exceeding long maximum
